Config

Most defaults in ATK can be changed via a config file. This module allows for the configuration file to be viewed and edited.

AstroToolkit.Config.editconfig(key, value)[source]

Allows for config values to be edited. See Config Keys for a description of available keys.

Parameters:

  • key (str) – config key

  • value (str) – value to assign to this config key

Returns:

None


AstroToolkit.Config.openconfig()[source]

Opens the config in the default text editor. See Config Keys for a description of available keys.

Returns:

None


AstroToolkit.Config.outputconfig()[source]

Prints the current config file to stdout.

Returns:

None


AstroToolkit.Config.resetconfig()[source]

Resets the config to default values.

Returns:

None
